exec: pm.test('claim succeeds or daily cap reached', function () { pm.expect([200,409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d.locations && d.locations.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('locationID', d.locations[0].id); if (d.characters && d.characters.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('characterID', d.characters[0].id); if (d.clues && d.clues.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('clueID', d.clues[0].id);
